content: Hypnosis is a psychological technique that can be utilized to help children manage anxiety and discomfort during dental procedures. It involves guiding the child into a state of focused attention and relaxation, allowing them to feel more at ease and cooperative during treatment. This method can be particularly effective in reducing fear and pain perception, as well as improving the overall dental experience for pediatric patients. By using age-appropriate language and imagery, dental professionals can tailor hypnosis sessions to suit the developmental level and individual needs of each child.
